additions.name: China Mobile Hohhot B25/B27 Expansion

status.summary: HVRAC publishes a whole-article contractor-attributed technical report confirming B25/B27 construction completion acceptance. October 10 is the report/relay date, not the exact acceptance day or authenticated contractor original date. Operation and whole-campus completion remain unverified.

locator.precision: Representative point inside the community-mapped named China Mobile Hohhot Data Center parent campus. It does not identify B25/B27 buildings, active work, entrance, survey point, parcel boundary or full current campus boundary.
locator.identity_review: The official March 24 CSCEC award identifies China Mobile Hohhot Data Center B25/B27 in Hohhot Helingeer New District. The October 10 contractor-attributed report names the same campus and B25/B27. OSM way 699967332 is explicitly named 中国移动呼和浩特数据中心. The source polygon identifies the named parent campus only; it does not resolve the B25/B27 building positions.
locator.uncertainty_reason: No measured horizontal accuracy is supplied for the OSM campus polygon. Offsets between this parent-campus marker and B25/B27 are unknown.

additions.distinctness_review: All 412 ninth-baseline site and 437 project rows were searched, with China rows checked for Hohhot and 呼和浩特 aliases; no match. The nearest existing representative point is China Mobile International Information Port, Beijing, approximately 376.5 km away. This is one parent campus and one jointly reported B25/B27 project; B17/B18 and the separate Haoyang Yunqi proposal are excluded.
additions.successor_review: The October 10 technical report is the selected dated completed-state confirmation. Contractor archive navigation did not recover the original article. No later primary operational confirmation was recovered in this bounded pass. Completion of the B25/B27 scope does not complete B17/B18 or the entire campus.
